modules.description: Single flat PRESENT-80 block cipher with bit-serial I/O, 31-round encryption FSM, asynchronous active-low reset, and serial load/unload interface.
modules.name: present80

ports.description: Serial load enable; shift one bit per rising edge while high
ports.name: load_en

ports.description: Serial data in, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
ports.name: din

ports.description: Serial unload enable; shift ciphertext out while high and done asserted
ports.name: shift_out_en

ports.description: Serial data out; drives state[63] while unloading, 0 otherwise
ports.name: dout

ports.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
ports.name: done

rationale: The spec mandates a single flat Verilog-2005/2012 module with no sub-modules. All logic — FSM (LOAD/ENCRYPT/DONE), serial shift-in/out, addRoundKey, sBoxLayer (generate+assign over 16 nibbles using localparam SBOX slice), pLayer (generate+assign using P(i)=(i*16)mod63), key schedule (rotate-left-61, S-box top nibble, XOR round counter into bits[19:15]), and all internal registers (state, key_reg, round, load_cnt, unload_cnt) — is implemented inside the single present80 module.
